protocol.selection: All four physical perturbations of original lane49, selected for follow-up after the near-zero final GPU window. No cases are removed by the outcome.
protocol.scope: New conditional numerical follow-up, separate from the frozen activity cohort and local interval theorems.

cases.sample_scope: Unprojected full 23D state continuation from the archived probe endpoint.

settings.shooting_trigger: Smallest lag with final physical max error <1e-5 and recent median max error <1e-4.

limitations: Floating-point conditional destination diagnosis, not an interval proof or basin measure.
Any cluster projection is measured and declared only after full-space sampling.
An apparently periodic endpoint is not assumed stable; the complete 23D monodromy is requested.

reference_comparison.comparison_scope: Floating-point phase optimization and optimal row assignment; not a validated orbit equivalence theorem.
